title: Photo Monologue
instructions: Вы получите задание с двумя иллюстрациями. Подготовьтесь к монологу по плану. На выполнение задания даётся 1,5 минуты на подготовку и 2,5 минуты на ответ.

tasks.title: Solo or in company
tasks.prompt: Imagine that you are preparing a video project "Solo or in company" and want to discuss with friends photos of two types of travelling. Leave a voice message to a friend and describe the photos, using the plan below.
plan: — give a general statement introducing the two photos and their common theme;
— compare and contrast the photos (what is common and what is different);
— say 1-2 advantages of the type of travelling shown in each photo;
— say 1-2 disadvantages of the type of travelling shown in each photo;
— say which of the two types of travelling you would prefer and why;
tasks.opinionQuestion: which type of travelling you would prefer and why
